content_metadata.description: Tutorial video on how to create a running head for an APA paper using Microsoft Word.

qAndA.question: What specific phrase does the narrator type before the shortened title of the paper in the running head?
What is the maximum character limit for the running head, including spaces and punctuation, mentioned in the video?

qAndA.answer: By repeatedly pressing the Tab key.
qAndA.question: How does the narrator ensure that the page number in the running head is aligned to the right side?

qAndA.answer: The narrator scrolls up and down through multiple pages of the document.
qAndA.question: After inserting the page number on the second page, what specific action does the narrator take to demonstrate the running head across the document?

qAndA.answer: The mood is neutral and instructional. It's established through the narrator's calm and clear voice, the straightforward visual demonstration, and the absence of any background music or sound effects.

activities.description: Narrator introduces the tutorial topic: how to create a running head for an APA paper.

scenes.title: Introduction

videoEditingDetails.description: Title card with text "APA - Running head: a simple method", "Camosun College", "April 2012", "1:26 min"
Cut to a Microsoft Word document

activities.description: Narrator instructs to go to "Insert" and select "Header" in Microsoft Word.
Narrator types "Running head:" followed by a shortened version of the paper's title in all caps.
Narrator explains the character limit for the running head (appears as text on screen).
Narrator inserts the page number using "Current Position" and "Plain Number".
Narrator tabs the page number to the right side of the header.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Detailed instructions on APA paper running head setup.

narrativeProgression.description: Step-by-step guide on setting up the running head on the first page.

scenes.thematicElements: Practical demonstration of creating a running head.
scenes.title: Creating the Running Head on the First Page

videoEditingDetails.description: Mouse cursor highlights the relevant options in Microsoft Word.

activities.description: Narrator navigates to the second page of the document.
Narrator repeats the process of inserting the shortened title in all caps.
Narrator tabs across and adds the page number again.
Narrator scrolls through the document to demonstrate the consistent running head.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Ensuring running head is consistent across document pages.

narrativeProgression.description: Illustrates applying the same running head format to subsequent pages.

scenes.thematicElements: Continuation and consistency of APA formatting.

youtube_description:
Demonstrates how to create a running head in Microsoft Word in accordance with the APA style. 

Originally created by Richard Baer (Camosun College) on April 20, 2012 using Camtasia Studio. The original .mp4  and Camtasia Studio project files can be downloaded from the Animated Tutorial Sharing (ANTS) Project repository at the University of Calgary Dspace: https://dspace.ucalgary.ca/handle/1880/48938
